title: Frances Frei on Incorruptible: 'I was LOUD. Shouting, loud.'
summary: Harvard Business School professor Frances Frei finishes Incorruptible and writes Eric a comment that gets straight to it — a vintage Frei reaction landing as a fresh public endorsement on top of her original blurb.
blockquote: I typically read in silence, either in deep thought, or if Im honest, in pleasant distraction. But reading Incorruptible, I was LOUD. Shouting, loud. Exclaiming, loud. Hooting and hollering, loud. You introduce us to the best version of ourselves and then give us a playbook to get there. Gratitude.
attribution_title: UPS Foundation Professor of Service Management, Harvard Business School
